title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map calendar archives for 2019–2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026, with captured text/images and explicit source gaps.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 caption exports. Daily Maps: 2026 has 201 maps/198 dates plus two undated commentaries; 2025 has 246/242; 2024 has 251/247; 2023 has 248/245; 2022 has 158/157, May 16–December 30, plus separate older context; 2021 has 250/246 plus one malformed-date article; 2020 has 251/248 with 502 image references across 502 unique files, including one qualified 400-pixel inline chart; 2019 has 248/246 with 496 image references across 495 unique files. All 2,860 scoped calendar dates recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Annual snapshots retain gaps and duplicate dates. The 2022 early-year gap, source-year exceptions, malformed dates and image qualifications remain explicit. Near ATHs uses its independently reviewed 2021 date in that annual archive; completed earlier snapshots are unchanged. No trading validation.
